title: General Discharge Safety Guidance
content: Use the clinician-approved medication list, follow-up plan, and red-flag advice in the discharge record.
review_scope: Synthetic discharge-plan safety education; not patient-specific prescribing.

title: Diabetes Home Monitoring Education
content: Home monitoring instructions must match the clinician-provided discharge plan and should not introduce a new medication regimen.
review_scope: Synthetic patient education only; follow the clinician-provided plan.

title: Hypertension Follow-up Guidance
content: Follow-up timing and monitoring tasks must be taken from the documented clinical plan or confirmed by a reviewer.
review_scope: Follow-up reminders must be clinician-confirmed; no timing inference.

title: Medication Reconciliation Safety
content: A discharge medication list must be reconciled before the plan is finalized. Missing or conflicting medication information requires clinician review.
review_scope: Medication reconciliation safety for synthetic teaching cases.

title: Red Flag Communication Guidance
content: Patient-facing plans should use the documented care-team contact pathway for worsening symptoms and must not invent emergency thresholds.
review_scope: General communication only; no emergency threshold inference.

title: Home Support and Care Coordination
content: Discharge coordination should record clinician-confirmed follow-up tasks and known support needs. Unconfirmed services must be reviewed rather than promised.
review_scope: Care coordination prompts for synthetic teaching cases.
